column1: #  Program sprint reports — sourced from "Program_Sprint_NN_Report.xlsx" (Summary + All Tickets sheets;
#  sprint # is in the filename/title, not a sheet). This LOB has only one sprint report.
#  Completion % = the Summary's "% Complete (excl. blocked)" = completed / (total - pending-3rd - waiting),
#  the in-our-control basis (Program's "blocked" is explicitly Pending 3rd Party / Waiting for customer).

column7: Sprint 44. In-our-control completion 85.7% (18 of 21 after 1 Pending-3rd-Party); raw % Complete was 81.8% (18/22).

Sprint 45 (Oct 12-23). Completion 78.9% (15 of 19 at sprint start; 0 blocked). Per Amy's rule, 11 open-capacity / mid-sprint-added tickets are excluded from the completion denominator (see the report's Added Mid-Sprint tab). Complete = Done/Resolved/Acceptance Testing/Awaiting-Publish-to-Live.

Sprint 46 (Oct 26-Nov 6). 90.6% (29 of 32; 0 blocked). Per Amy's rule, 8 open-capacity / mid-sprint-added tickets excluded from completion (Added Mid-Sprint tab). Complete = Done/Resolved/Acceptance Testing/Awaiting-Publish-to-Live.
